result.description:
Duties and Responsibilities:
As a IT Consultant/Programmer, you will be responsible for analysing, assessing, designing, developing, testing, implementing maintaining and supporting quality applications that supports the company’s key objectives.

Main responsibilities include:
• Writing software code, automated unit tests, and debugging the code to delivery documented working software that meets the requirements in accordance to FedEx secure code practices, policies and established coding standards.
• Translate business requirements and system requirements into detailed technical specifications or business features and user stories using the SAFe Agile framework.
Provide technical mentoring and guidance to other developers.
• Design application solutions that meet complex business requirements, modelling the solution and implement code reviews and other quality management practices across a team of developers.
• Implement software development design patterns to deliver on complex technical requirements to deliver well-engineered working software that is scalable, resilient, maintainable, performant, secure, fault-tolerant, portable, extensible, reusable, testable and easy to use.
• Design and execute complex application testing for functional and non-functional testing including stress and load testing, building test doubles/hubs, test management data, regression testing and complex scenario and use case management.

Analyst and Support Tasks:
• Consultation and analysis of key systems with Stakeholder.
• Collaborating with the enterprise Applications Team and Operations Team around production incidents involving integration to directly or indirectly ensure their timely resolution/recovery and preventative measures are taken to avoid recurrence and minimize business impact
• Maintenance of operational and end-user documentation
• Planning and technical delivery of integration work packages

Experience and Qualifications:
• Minimum 2+ years experience using Java JMS API in a Linux/Unix environment.
• Experience in developing Java applications in Cloud Native environment.
• Experience in building microservices using Spring Core and Spring Cloud.
• Extensive knowledge and experience in using Microservices Architecture Patterns.
• Experience in TDD and BDD practices using Java & Spring based Junit & BDD frameworks.
• Good knowledge and experience in using Kafka for message streaming and for event driven pub/sub notifications.
• Experience in modern networking, IPV4 stack, ICMP, UDP, TCP/IP, socket programming.
• Experience with working with databases e.g. MSSQL, MYSQL, Informix, Oracle.
• Proven ability to lead the development of software development projects.
• Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, information systems or similar
SAFe Agile certification highly desirable

result.description:
Australian Fishing Enterprises (AFE) is the largest exporter of Southern Bluefin Tuna in Australia. Our tuna is exported around the world for sale in international marketplaces as a premium sushi/sashimi product. We specialise in the fishing, ranching and grow out of Southern Bluefin Tuna and control the entire process from catching to feeding, harvesting, processing and delivery. 
This position is available from November 2026 or sooner for suitable candidates with a valid AMSA Near Coastal Marine Engine Driver Grade 2/3 Certification, for a placement for up to 4 years.
Vessel Engineer Duties:
The Employee will be required to perform certain duties as listed below whilst at Sea (offshore) and on the Farm Site (inshore), although this list is not exhaustive it is a generalised overview of duties.
Engineer Duties:
•	Engine Room Watchkeeping 
•	Periodical Engine Servicing
•	Maintain machinery to an Operational capacity
•	Use of Pumping Systems
•	Vessel Slipping and Docking
•	Vessel Maintenance/Repairs 
•	Vessel Crane Operation
•	Refuelling & Bunkering
•	Loading and Unloading of vessel at Sea and On-shore
•	Reporting to Vessel Master
•	Maintenance and repairs coordinated with Fleet Manager
•	Forklift operation on-shore only (if Licensed)
•	Fish Feeding 
•	Repetitive Manual labour 
•	Vessel cleaning and house keeping 
•	Vessel Mooring/Berthing 
•	Net mending 
•	Rope work (Splicing, Knotting etc.)
•	Farm Pontoon Maintenance
Also including Deck Hand duties:
Deckhand Duties:
•	Ability to stand on unstable surfaces and undertake general duties on a day-to-day basis as advised by the Master 
•	Forklift operation (only if Licensed from previous deployment on SWP)  onshore only
•	Loading and Unloading of vessel at Sea and On-shore
•	Deck Machinery Operation
•	Fish Feeding 
•	Fish Processing and Packing
•	Maintenance as directed by Vessel Engineer
•	Repetitive Manual labour 
•	Vessel cleaning and house keeping 
•	Vessel Mooring/Berthing 
•	Net mending & Rope work (Splicing, Knotting etc.)
•	High Pressure Water Blasting
•	Painting by Hand and/or Spray
•	Farm Pontoon Maintenance
•	Portable hand tool use

The Employee will be required to perform the following additional duties whilst at Sea for Offshore Operations.
Navigation Watch:
• Keeping Lookout for other Vessels
• Maintaining Vessel Course as per Master’s instructions
• Vessel Log recording
• Watch Handover to next watch keeper
• Reporting to the Master
• Radio frequency monitoring
A Navigational watch can per performed at any time throughout the day or night, they are generally 1.5-2 hours in duration.

Additional Deck Duties:
• Tender vessel operation
• Launch and retrieval of tender
• Fish Sampling/Chumming
• Maintenance as directed by Vessel Engineer
• Repetitive Manual labour
• Vessel cleaning and house keeping
• Vessel Mooring/Berthing
*This job description has been designed to indicate the general nature and level of work performed by employees within this classification. It is not designed to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities and qualifications required of employees assigned to the role.

Hours of operation are determined by the daily operational needs,.
January – July Operations are 7 days per week; you can work up to 6 days in a week. Up to 12 hours per day.
August to December Operations are 5 days per week Monday to Friday, you will work up to 5 days in a week, 8 hours per day.
Offshore Operations:
Tow & Support operations begin in December through to late March. If Quota is exhausted quickly the Offshore Operations will cease before late March.
Hours of operation whilst at Sea are from Sunrise to Sunset plus a navigational watch. 

Renumeration is paid as per the Award Rate, paid on a fortnightly basis. Farm work completed inshore and onshore will be calculated at the applicable hourly Farm rate. Aquaculture Award:(https://awards.fairwork.gov.au/MA000114.html)(https://calculate.fairwork.gov.au/payguides/fairwork/ma000114/pdf)
OFFSHORE OPERATIONS
An additional contract is put in place alongside original Deckhand Contract to cover the periods Offshore for Tow & Support operations to classify Duties and Remuneration (there is no Award that covers the "At Sea" roles), contract renumeration is calculated from experience and seamanship knowledge.

This is not a FIFO position. Successful applicants will need to based in Port Lincoln for the duration of the contracted period.

result.description:
On behalf of our client Gulf Hydraulic, we are seeking a qualified Fitter General, fitter and turners /Machinists for a full-time position in Malaga. Gulf Hydraulics Australia is a leader in the Hydraulics Industry for the service and repair of Hydraulic Pumps, Motors and Cylinders and has been recognised as service provider for the offshore, industrial and mining sectors.

Primary responsibilities Fitters and Turners
 
- Assembled and fitted precision hydraulic cylinder components, including barrels, rods, pistons, glands, and specialized seal kits, to full operational compliance.
- Operated workshop machinery and heavy press equipment to accurately install interference-fit bushes and components.
- Conducted diagnostic pressure testing, including bypass and static pressure leak testing, to verify fluid power integrity and safety standards.
- Utilized precision hand tools and torque equipment to tighten fasteners and sub-assemblies to exact OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturer) specifications.
- Maintained quality control records, documented test data, and assigned unique job identifiers/ID tracking to completed units prior to final surface finishing (coating/spraying).
- Setting up and operating conventional lathes and milling machines to turn, face, thread, or bore metal stock.
- Machining new or worn parts (like reclaiming a worn cylinder rod or machining a new gland/piston from scratch) to exact tolerances.
- Using engineering drawings and precision measuring tools (micrometers, vernier calipers) to machine components down to the millimeter.

Primary responsibilities Machinist
•     Operate machine tools such as lathes, milling machines,
•     Manufacture rods, glands, pistons, barrels, bases, fittings, bushes
•     Review specifications for a job.
•     Calculate where to cut or bore.
•     Shape steel, aluminum, other materials.
•     Determine how fast or slow workpiece is fed into machine.
•     Determine how much material to remove.
•     Select tools and materials for the job.
•     Plan the sequence of cutting and finishing operations.
•     Mark the workpiece to show where cuts should be made.
•     Position workpiece on the lathe or milling machine.
•     Monitor and control feed rate and speed.
•     Ensure workpiece is properly lubricated and/or cooled.
•     Regulate temperature of workpiece.
•     Detect problems by listening for specific sounds.
•     Adjust cutting speed to compensate for harmonic vibrations.
•     Monitor the accuracy of cuts.
•     Replace dull cutting tools.
•     Check accuracy of work against specifications.
•     Ability to use precision tools (eg. Micrometers internal & external)
•     Use manual machinery.

Qualifications/Knowledge/Skills/Experience
 
•     Adequate work experience or Certificate Ill in Engineering - Mechanical Trade (Fitter & Machinist)
•     Good mechanical aptitude.
•     Excellent reading comprehension
•     Physical Stamina


The salary range is from $79,500 to $85,000 per year plus super.

## Position Overview
We are looking for a skilled and motivated Systems Administrator to join our team and take ownership of the organisation's IT infrastructure. In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring the stability, integrity, and efficient operation of our server environments, networks, and supporting systems. The ideal candidate is a proactive problem-solver with a strong technical background and a commitment to delivering reliable, secure, and high-performing IT services. This position suits an experienced professional who thrives in a dynamic environment and can manage both day-to-day operations and longer-term infrastructure planning.
## Key Responsibilities
- Install, configure, and maintain server hardware, operating systems, software, and associated infrastructure to ensure optimal performance and availability
- Diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve server-related hardware and software malfunctions across workstations, servers, and communication infrastructure, providing timely service support to minimise disruption
- Monitor network performance and system health on an ongoing basis, identifying potential issues and making proactive adjustments to maintain service quality and reliability
- Prepare and maintain comprehensive technical documentation, including operational procedures, system logs, configuration records, and IT policies and instructions
- Assess current and future infrastructure needs by regularly surveying existing systems and recommending enhancements to server capacity, network design, and technology implementation
- Ensure computer site design and layout allows all hardware and software components to integrate and function cohesively within the broader IT environment
- Manage system security measures including user access controls, patch management, antivirus solutions, and firewall configurations to protect organisational data and assets
- Plan, implement, and test backup and disaster recovery procedures to safeguard data integrity and ensure business continuity
- Administer and support databases, virtualisation platforms, and cloud-based services as required by the organisation
- Collaborate with IT team members, vendors, and internal stakeholders to deliver infrastructure projects and resolve escalated technical issues
- Provide guidance and technical support to end users and junior IT staff, promoting best practices and ensuring effective use of systems and tools
## Required Qualifications & Skills
- Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
- Proven experience in a Systems Administrator or similar IT infrastructure role
- Strong working knowledge of Windows Server and/or Linux operating systems, including installation, configuration, and maintenance
- Demonstrated experience with network administration, including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPN, and firewall management
- Proficiency in virtualisation technologies such as VMware or Hyper-V
- Experience with backup and disaster recovery solutions and the ability to develop and test recovery procedures
- Sound understanding of IT security principles, including access management, patch management, and vulnerability remediation
- Ability to prepare clear technical documentation and maintain accurate system records
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to diagnose and resolve complex technical issues under pressure
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to liaise effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
- Demonstrated ability to manage competing priorities and work both autonomously and as part of a collaborative team
## Preferred Qualifications
- Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate or equivalent cloud certification
- Experience with cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud
- Familiarity with scripting languages such as PowerShell, Bash, or Python for task automation
- ITIL Foundation certification or experience working within an ITIL-aligned service management framework
- Experience with Active Directory, Group Policy, and Microsoft 365 administration
- Knowledge of monitoring tools such as Nagios, PRTG, or SolarWinds
- Prior experience working in an enterprise or multi-site environment
## Why Join Us?
- Be part of a supportive and collaborative IT team that values knowledge sharing, continuous improvement, and professional growth
- Access ongoing training, certification support, and clear pathways for career advancement within the organisation
- Enjoy a flexible working environment that promotes a healthy work-life balance, including hybrid working arrangements where applicable
- Contribute to meaningful infrastructure projects that directly impact the organisation's operations and strategic direction
- Competitive remuneration package with additional benefits, in an organisation that recognises and rewards performance
## Job Details
- Job Type: Full-time, Permanent
- Work Schedule: 8-hour shift
- Salary: $70,000 – $120,000 per year + Super

About Us

Advanced Group Australia is a leading provider of skilled labour solutions across construction, civil, and industrial sectors. With a strong presence in New South Wales and an ongoing commitment to safety, quality, and workforce development, we work with top-tier clients on major infrastructure and building projects. Our team takes pride in delivering reliable, qualified personnel who keep projects moving and completed to the highest standards.

We are currently seeking an experienced and reliable Sheet Metal Worker to join our growing team.

Role

As a Sheet Metal Worker, you will be responsible for fabricating, assembling, installing, and repairing sheet metal products and structures. This includes working with materials such as stainless steel, aluminium, and galvanised iron for applications in construction, HVAC, and industrial installations. You will collaborate with supervisors, tradespeople, and site managers to deliver precise and safe workmanship that aligns with project specifications.

Key Responsibilities & Duties
- Read and interpret technical drawings, blueprints, and specifications for fabrication and installation.
- Measure, cut, bend, and shape sheet metal using hand tools, machines, and cutting equipment.
- Assemble and join sheet metal components using welding, riveting, and fastening techniques.
- Install sheet metal products, such as ductwork, roofing, flashing, panels, and frameworks on construction sites.
- Perform modifications or repairs on existing installations, ensuring all work meets quality and safety standards.
- Operate and maintain workshop machinery and tools with care and attention to safety protocols.
- Conduct inspections and quality checks on finished products or installations.
- Comply with all site safety requirements and Advanced Group’s work health and safety (WHS) procedures.

Skills & Qualifications
- AQF Certificate III in Engineering – Fabrication Trade (Sheet Metal Working) or similar (ANZSCO Skill Level 3).
- Minimum 3 years’ experience in sheet metal fabrication, installation, or maintenance.
- Proficiency in working with a range of sheet metal tools and machinery.
- Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings and specifications.
- Strong attention to detail and problem-solving skills.
- Good communication skills and ability to work as part of a team.
- White Card (Construction Induction).
- Valid driver’s licence and reliable transport.

Australian citizens and permanent residents encouraged to apply.

Salary & Location
Salary: $78,000 – $80,000 per annum plus superannuation (commensurate with experience).
